verdict.rationale: Helicone publishes a REST API reference (e.g., the 'Get Requests' endpoint page) with a copyable curl example for POST /v1/request/query, backed by a published OpenAPI spec at /swagger.json. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive, such as an in-browser 'try it' playground that runs requests, so only the reference-with-examples half of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive in-browser request runner, multi-language runnable snippets, broad endpoint coverage, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
